mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_statistics ( id, created_count, paid_count, cancelled_count, created_amount, last_consumed_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, CASE WHEN #{operationType} = 'CREATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{operationType} = 'PAY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{operationType} = 'CANCEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{operationType} = 'CREATE' THEN COALESCE(#{totalAmount}, 0) ELSE 0 END, #{consumedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET created_count = order_statistics.created_count + EXCLUDED.created_count, paid_count = order_statistics.paid_count + EXCLUDED.paid_count, cancelled_count = order_statistics.cancelled_count + EXCLUDED.cancelled_count, created_amount = order_statistics.created_amount + EXCLUDED.created_amount, last_consumed_at = CASE WHEN order_statistics.last_consumed_at IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.last_consumed_at ELSE GREATEST(order_statistics.last_consumed_at, EXCLUDED.last_consumed_at) END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
